title: Porta Nuova 19
description: Sun, UTCI, wind, façade and daylight analysis across outdoor, building and interior scales for a 35,000 sqm office.
body: Sun hours, Universal Thermal Climate Index (UTCI) and wind analysis guided landscape design and assessed pedestrian comfort outdoors, while a vertical louver study shaped façade shading through solar radiation analysis. Indoor daylight analysis — Useful Daylight Illuminance (UDI), Spatial Daylight Autonomy (sDA) and Annual Solar Exposure (ASE) — ensured daylight autonomy and minimized glare across the 35,000 sqm office.
Specific analysis outputs remain confidential to the client.
